name: Village Underground
summary: An independent venue in a converted Victorian warehouse in Shoreditch, recognisable by the tube carriages on its roof; it started out as affordable artists' studios. Its programme mixes new and emerging acts with big-name artists.

music.notes: Club nights and live gigs most nights of the week, many booked by outside promoters; Time Out notes it often books leading electronic DJs alongside up-and-coming artists.

crowd: The venue says it welcomes a diverse audience and works to be a safe space free of harassment and discrimination for everyone there.

accessibility.notes: The Great Eastern Street entrance is fully accessible; the Holywell Lane one has a couple of steps. A ramped, raised viewing platform has seating and wheelchair space (Seated/Wheelchair + Carer tickets on DICE). No accessible bar; staff can serve you if you have no carer. Strobes at some shows.

cost.notes: Fully cashless: pay by card or contactless. The venue's own tickets are sold through DICE.

age_policy: Gigs 16+ (16–17s with an adult); club nights 18+.

evidence.quote: Village Underground is a renovated turn-of-the-century warehouse in the heart of Shoreditch, East London.
our curated programme showcases the best in new and emerging talent alongside world-class artists.
Home to cutting-edge culture, clubbing and live music
we’re one of the few remaining independent venues in East London.
Village Underground, with its rich history and unique character, has transformed from a Victorian coal warehouse into one of the most iconic cultural venues in London.

You can’t miss Village Underground thanks to the four brightly coloured, graffiti-covered tube carriages perched on its roof. But the main draw of this venue that opened as an affordable artists’ studio is the renovated Victorian warehouse space inside.
which often hosts top electronic DJs and exciting up-and-coming artists
Most nights of the week you can catch an artist or DJ on the cusp of huge things in our intimate, underground, setting.
Shows at Village Underground are usually booked by external promoters
We welcome diversity in our audience and work to create a safe space for everyone present
VU is a club for people to enjoy music without fear of harassment or discrimination.

We have 2 entrances/exits – one is located on Holywell Lane and has a couple of steps, the other is located on Great Eastern Street and is fully accessible. There is permanent ramp access to the accessible viewing area where we have a raised platform and offer seating or wheelchair space.
We do not have an accessible bar however we can provide a bartender if a customer is without a carer.
Seated/Wheelchair + Carer Tickets are only available to purchase on Dice.
We do use strobe and flashing lighting in the venue on some shows
We have one dedicated accessible toilet. This is located at the front of the building next to the cloakroom area. It is accessible via the ramp from the main floor.
Our venue is now 100% cashless. All payments must be made by card or contactless methods.
VU’s ticket allocation is sold through Dice.
Live music events are strictly over 16 and each 16-17 year old under 18 must be accompanied by one responsible adult
Any Club night is strictly over 18 and right of admission will be reserved.
